# escapeXml

<link-summary>Escapes the characters XML reserves.</link-summary>

<web-summary>escapeXml() — Escapes the characters XML reserves. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>html</code> · Since: 1.0.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function escapeXml(value: string): string;
```

The same five characters as `escapeHtml`, for content going into an XML document rather than a page.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type     | Description                                  |
| :-------- | :------- | :------------------------------------------- |
| `value`   | `string` | The string to convert. It must not be empty. |

## Returns

`string` — the escaped string.

## Throws

| Exception              | Condition                               |
| :--------------------- | :-------------------------------------- |
| `EmptyStringException` | the value is not a string, or is empty. |

## Examples

### Converting

```javascript
escapeXml("<a>&"); // => "&lt;a&gt;&amp;"
```
